tokens.npc_dota_hero_rubick_bio:
Any mage can cast a spell or two, and a few may even study long enough to become a wizard, but only the most talented are allowed to be recognized as a Magus. Yet as with any sorcerer's circle, a sense of community has never guaranteed competitive courtesy.

Already a renowned duelist and scholar of the grander world of sorcery, it had never occurred to Rubick that he might perhaps be Magus material until he was in the midst of his seventh assassination attempt. As he casually tossed the twelfth of a string of would-be killers from a high balcony, it dawned on him how utterly unimaginative the attempts on his life had become. Where once the interruption of a fingersnap or firehand might have put a cheerful spring in his step, it had all become so very predictable. He craved greater competition. Therefore, donning his combat mask, he did what any wizard seeking to ascend the ranks would do: he announced his intention to kill a Magus.

Rubick quickly discovered that to threaten one Magus is to threaten them all, and they fell upon him in force. Each antagonist's spell was an unstoppable torrent of energy, and every attack a calculated killing blow. But very soon something occurred that Rubick's foes found unexpected: their arts appeared to turn against them. Inside the magic maelstrom, Rubick chuckled, subtly reading and replicating the powers of one in order to cast it against another, sowing chaos among those who had allied against him. Accusations of betrayal began to fly, and soon the sorcerers turned one upon another without suspecting who was behind their undoing.

When the battle finally drew to a close, all were singed and frozen, soaked and cut and pierced. More than one lay dead by an ally's craft. Rubick stood apart, sore but delighted in the week's festivities. None had the strength to argue when he presented his petition of assumption to the Hidden Council, and the Insubstantial Eleven agreed as one to grant him the title of Grand Magus.

mechanics
fields.value:
* {{Symbol|a|Sub}}
** Does not prematurely end the {{M|upward movement}} component upon cast.
** {{Symbol|Affect|Self}}
*** Replaces {{A|Rubick|Telekinesis}} upon cast, and stays active until the {{Symbol|Target|Unit}} targeted unit lands.
*** Rubick is unable to level Telekinesis up while this [[sub-ability]] is active.
*** Cannot {{M|shift-queue}} this sub-ability.
*** Does not interrupt {{M|channeling}} sources.
*** {{cf|shdnotes}}
**** Rubick can cast the sub-ability when being affected by the following sources:
***** {{M|Cyclone}} sources.
***** {{M|Forced movement}} sources.
***** {{M|Invulnerability}} sources.
***** {{M|Stun}} sources
***** {{M|Sleep}} sources.
***** {{M|Taunt}} sources.
**** Cannot cast the sub-ability while being affected by the following sources:
**** While {{M|cannot act}}.
**** {{M|Fear}} sources.
**** {{M|Silence}} sources.
*** {{Symbol|fx|v}}
**** The selected {{Symbol|Target|Point}} point-targeted location is marked by green ability particles, visible ally-only.
** {{Symbol|Target|Unit}} {{Symbol|Affect|Enemy}}
*** When cast on enemy units, the sub-ability allows Rubick to determine where the lifted enemy will land after the lift duration.
*** The sub-ability can also be cast multiple times, the lifted enemy lands at the last {{Symbol|Target|Point}} point-targeted location.
** {{Symbol|bonus shd}} {{Symbol|Target|Unit}} {{Symbol|Affect|Ally}}
*** {{cf|shdnotes}} The sub-ability turns inactive upon cast.

* The ability effects are applied as follows upon cast:
*# {{Symbol|Forced Movement}}
*#* Applies up to a max {{#expr:{{#var:Telekinesis Land value1}}/{{#var:Telekinesis Land value2}}}} ({{Symbol|bonus shd}} {{ValueColor||{{#expr:{{#var:Telekinesis Land value1 shd}}/{{#var:Telekinesis Land value2}}}}|shd}})-speed [[forced movement]] on the lifted {{Symbol|Target|Unit}} unit-targeted enemy, toward the {{Symbol|Target|Point}} point-targeted location at the last {{#var:Telekinesis Land value2}}-second of the lift duration.
*#* {{Symbol|bonus shd}} {{Symbol|Affect|Ally}}
*#** {{cf|shdnotes}}
*#*** For the lifted {{Symbol|Target|Unit}} unit-targeted ally, the sub-ability sets the remaining lift duration to {{ValueColor||{{#var:Telekinesis Land type2 value2 shd}}|shd}} seconds, and applies up to a max {{ValueColor||{{#expr:{{#var:Telekinesis Land value1}}/{{#var:Telekinesis Land type2 value2 shd}}}}|shd}}-speed forced movement toward the {{Symbol|Target|Point}} point-targeted location. 
*#* {{Symbol|bonus cas}}
*#** {{cf|expr}} {{Code|[[Abilities#Target Point|Point]]Distance < MaxDistance}} Telekinesis Land moves the affected unit toward the [[Abilities#Target Point|point-targeted]] distance.
*#** Other than that, when cast more than max distance, the Telekinesis Land moves the {{Symbol|Target|Unit}} unit-targeted enemy to the max distance.
*# {{Symbol|Projectile|Impact}}
*#* [[File:Dota2 Rubick Telekinesis Land Visualization icon-1.png|84px]][[File:Dota2 Rubick Telekinesis Land Visualization icon-2.png|84px]]
*#** Can affect other enemy units within Circle [[File:Dota2 Letter-f.png|F|21px]] at max {{Symbol|bonus cas}} {{Symbol|bonus aoe}} {{Code|{{calc|v1+v2+{{#var:Telekinesis Land value1}}|v1={{#var:Telekinesis cast range}}|v2={{#var:Telekinesis Land value3}}}} + {{ValueColor||{{#var:Telekinesis Land Throw Bonud shd}}|shd|x}} + f([[Rubick#Arcane Supremacy|ArcaneSupremacy]] CastRange)}}-distance away with the [[cast range]], max throw distance, and stun radius.
*# Applies {{Symbol|Stun}} {{Symbol|Modifier|Debuff}} {{Code|rubick_telekinesis_[[stun]]}} to other enemy units within the radius.
*#* {{Symbol|Trees}}
*#** [[Trees]] centered around the affected enemy unit are destroyed.
*# {{cf|talnotes}} The {{M|magical}} {{M|spell damage}} to all enemy units within the radius.
*#* Acquiring the {{M|talent|t=t3l}} immediately updates the current lift instance.

data.bio_loc:
Any mage can cast a spell or two, and a few may even study long enough to become a wizard, but only the most talented are allowed to be recognized as a Magus. Yet as with any sorcerer's circle, a sense of community has never guaranteed competitive courtesy.

Already a renowned duelist and scholar of the grander world of sorcery, it had never occurred to Rubick that he might perhaps be Magus material until he was in the midst of his seventh assassination attempt. As he casually tossed the twelfth of a string of would-be killers from a high balcony, it dawned on him how utterly unimaginative the attempts on his life had become. Where once the interruption of a fingersnap or firehand might have put a cheerful spring in his step, it had all become so very predictable. He craved greater competition. Therefore, donning his combat mask, he did what any wizard seeking to ascend the ranks would do: he announced his intention to kill a Magus.

Rubick quickly discovered that to threaten one Magus is to threaten them all, and they fell upon him in force. Each antagonist's spell was an unstoppable torrent of energy, and every attack a calculated killing blow. But very soon something occurred that Rubick's foes found unexpected: their arts appeared to turn against them. Inside the magic maelstrom, Rubick chuckled, subtly reading and replicating the powers of one in order to cast it against another, sowing chaos among those who had allied against him. Accusations of betrayal began to fly, and soon the sorcerers turned one upon another without suspecting who was behind their undoing.

When the battle finally drew to a close, all were singed and frozen, soaked and cut and pierced. More than one lay dead by an ally's craft. Rubick stood apart, sore but delighted in the week's festivities. None had the strength to argue when he presented his petition of assumption to the Hidden Council, and the Insubstantial Eleven agreed as one to grant him the title of Grand Magus.
